highlights: The container platform tailored for Kubernetes multi-cloud, datacenter, and edge management
KubeSphere is a distributed operating system for cloud-native application management,
full-stack automated IT operation and streamlined DevOps workflows.
Provide a centralized control plane to manage multiple Kubernetes clusters, and support the ability to propagate an app to multiple K8s clusters across different cloud providers.
Provide fine-grained traffic management, observability and tracing for distributed microservice applications, provides visualization for traffic topology.
Provide an App Store for Helm-based applications, and offer application lifecycle management on Kubernetes platform.
